I appreciate your passion and commitment to this role, and I agree that your skills and qualifications are impressive. We have options ranging from June 1 to August 1, and I’d like to ensure we choose a date that aligns with your availability and the team's needs. What are your preferences regarding the start date?
I am eager to start! I have so many fresh ideas and can't wait to make this partnership official. How does June 1st sound?

I appreciate your eagerness and enthusiasm to begin. Starting on June 1st is an exciting prospect, but how about we consider starting on July 1st instead? This would provide us with ample time to prepare for your arrival and ensure a smooth transition. Let me know your thoughts on this date.
I'm sorry but the absolute latest I would be able to start would be June 15th. If it's later than that I will have to take another position I was offered.

Thank you for letting me know your constraints. We can certainly accommodate a June 15th start date. I’m glad we could reach an agreement that works for both of us. We’re excited to have you on board and look forward to your contributions to our team. Let’s move forward with the necessary paperwork to finalize your employment. Is there anything else you'd like to discuss or need from us at this point?
Sound great, thank you. No I have no other questions.
